name: Baldur's Gate: Dark Horizons
summary: Dark Horizons is a WeiDU-based tactical quest and encounter mod for the original Baldur's Gate (with the Tales of the Sword Coast expansion), Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition (BG:EE), Baldur's Gate Trilogy (BGT), and Enhanced Edition Trilogy (EET). The mod injects a major overarching storyline alongside numerous high-difficulty tactical combat scenarios across the game world.
